headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Board of County Commissioner meeting -Special on Thursday, December 3
blurb: A special BOCC session with two distinct parts. First, budget adjustments for 2027: the board will work through potential amendments including clarifying the wildfire mitigation budget, a $50,000 seed-money request from the Chamber of Commerce, and an additional cost contribution tied to a Youth Hangout project.
